note: Multiple Select adds a 'Select All / Uncheck All' master checkbox above configured multi-value checkboxes fields on node/media/taxonomy_term/site_setting_entity edit forms. It has no field/widget of its own. All persistent state is one config object multiple_select.settings, key 'table', a JSON-encoded string mapping '<entity_type>-<bundle>' -> array of field machine names (e.g. {"node-article":["field_x"]}). The helper only renders for fields whose form-display widget is 'Check boxes' (core options_buttons). Configure route multiple_select.admin_form (/admin/config/content/multiple-config), permission 'access multiple select config page'. Medium cases seed a known table map and read it back; hard cases add/remove a field to/from the node-article list, verified against the live config.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal contrib module multiple_select, which config object and key store the list of fields that get the 'Select All / Uncheck All' helper, and what is the format of that value?
evals.expected_output: The list lives in the config object multiple_select.settings under the key 'table'. The value is a JSON-encoded string mapping '<entity_type>-<bundle>' (e.g. node-article) to an array of field machine names, so it must be json_encode/json_decode-d rather than treated as a normal nested config array.

evals.prompt: I enabled multiple_select and registered a multi-value field, but no 'Select All' checkbox shows up on the node form. What are the requirements for the helper to actually appear on a field?
evals.expected_output: The field must be multi-value and its form-display widget must be 'Check boxes' (core options_buttons), because the module only injects the master checkbox when $form[field]['widget']['#type'] == 'checkboxes'. It also only alters node, media, taxonomy_term and site_setting_entity forms. A field registered in multiple_select.settings:table but shown with another widget (select list, autocomplete) gets nothing.

evals.prompt: Where is the admin configuration page for the Drupal multiple_select module, and which permission controls access to it?
evals.expected_output: The configure route is multiple_select.admin_form at /admin/config/content/multiple-config, gated by the 'access multiple select config page' permission. There you tick a bundle and pick which of its list_string/entity_reference fields get the helper.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, multiple_select has been configured to add its Select-All helper to one field on the Article content type. Inspect the live multiple_select configuration and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: field_ms_known: multiple_select.settings:table (a JSON string) decodes to {"node-article":["field_ms_known"]}.

evals.prompt: This site has multiple_select enabled for more than one field on the Article content type. Inspect the running configuration and list every Article field that currently has the Select-All helper enabled.
evals.expected_output: Two fields: field_ms_a and field_ms_b. multiple_select.settings:table decodes to {"node-article":["field_ms_a","field_ms_b"]}.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a multi-value checkboxes field field_ms_task. Using the multiple_select module, configure it so that field gets the 'Select All / Uncheck All' helper, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: multiple_select.settings:table (JSON string) must decode to a map whose 'node-article' entry includes field_ms_task, e.g. set table to json_encode(["node-article" => ["field_ms_task"]]) and save.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, field_ms_off on the Article content type currently has the multiple_select Select-All helper enabled. Remove the helper from that field (leave the field itself in place) and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: After the change, multiple_select.settings:table must no longer list field_ms_off under 'node-article' (remove it from the array, or clear the map). The field field_ms_off must still exist.
